cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS num_readings FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT max(wave_height) AS max_wave_height FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT AVG(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp FROM telemetry

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, MIN(speed) AS min_speed, MAX(speed) AS max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '2 days' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: max wave height per vessel per day
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) AS day, vessel, MAX(wave_height) AS max_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY day, vessel ORDER BY day, vessel

cases.question: daily minimum and maximum water temperature
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, MIN(water_temp) AS min_water_temp, MAX(water_temp) AS max_water_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS ts, vessel, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY ts, vessel ORDER BY ts, vessel

cases.question: average speed by hour of day
cases.reason: right values, hour_of_day returned as text
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT strftime('%H', ts) AS hour_of_day, AVG(speed) AS average_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day

cases.question: average wave height by day of the week
cases.reason: right values, day_of_week returned as text
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT strftime('%w', ts) AS day_of_week, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY day_of_week

cases.question: speed of Atlas every 10 minutes today
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts, speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Atlas' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY ts

cases.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT CAST(ts AS DATE) AS date, AVG(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

cases.question: which vessel was fastest on average in the last 24 hours
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: compare wave height of all vessels by hour over the last 12 hours
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: mean speed for the last 30 minutes in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '30 minutes' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

cases.question: Average wind from September 3 to September 5, 2026, hourly
cases.sql:
-- view: hourly
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= '2026-09-03 00:00:00' AND ts <= '2026-09-05 23:59:59' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: Average wave height for the last hour in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS bucket, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel IN ('Kestrel', 'Nomad') GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Compare vessel speed by hour over the last day excluding Aurora
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' AND vessel != 'Aurora' GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: how many readings had waves above 4 metres, per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS readings_above_4m FROM telemetry WHERE wave_height > 4 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Hourly average speed for vessels north of latitude 50 in the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Show hourly wind for Poseidon over the last 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT CAST(ts AS DATE) AS ts, AVG(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Poseidon' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY CAST(ts AS DATE) ORDER BY CAST(ts AS DATE)

cases.question: in how many hours did Solstice see wind above 30 knots
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT CAST(ts AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS hours_above_30_knots FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Solstice' AND wind > 30 GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

cases.question: table of the 10 highest hourly average wave heights
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT ts, vessel, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY ts, vessel ORDER BY avg_wave_height DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: the three fastest vessels by average speed in the past 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: which day had the strongest average wind
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT CAST(ts AS DATE) AS day, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY avg_wind DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel recorded the coldest water
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, MIN(water_temp) AS min_water_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY min_water_temp LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel got farthest east
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT vessel, lon FROM telemetry ORDER BY lon DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: correlation between wind and speed per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT
  wind,
  speed,
  vessel
FROM telemetry
WHERE
  ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '14 days'
ORDER BY
  vessel,
  wind

cases.question: difference between maximum and minimum water temperature per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, max(water_temp) - min(water_temp) AS temp_diff FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Compare speed and wave height by hour over the last 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Average ratio of wave height to wind speed per hour over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wave_height / wind) AS avg_wave_wind_ratio FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: average speed of each vessel in km/h over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed * 1.852) AS avg_speed_kmh FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: average speed per vessel in the first week versus the second week
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT CASE WHEN ts BETWEEN '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-09-07 23:59:54' THEN 'First Week' ELSE 'Second Week' END AS week, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY week, vessel ORDER BY week, vessel

cases.question: latest position of every vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT ts, vessel, lat, lon FROM telemetry ORDER BY ts DESC, vessel LIMIT 6

cases.question: where was Meridian yesterday
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT lat, lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Meridian' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: show all vessel tracks on a map
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT vessel, lat, lon FROM telemetry

cases.question: how many readings were taken north of 50 degrees latitude, per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS readings FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Aurora's average position per day
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, AVG(lat) AS avg_lat, AVG(lon) AS avg_lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: average wave height per ves
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: wind
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT ts, vessel, wind FROM telemetry ORDER BY ts, vessel

cases.question: speed last week
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT ts, vessel, speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY ts, vessel

cases.question: scatter of wind vs wave height
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT wind,wave_height FROM telemetry
